hook: A birthday cake is ready for the party.

lines.speaker: anna
lines.text: What were you doing when I called?

translation.vi: Bạn đang làm gì khi mình gọi?

lines.speaker: ben
lines.text: I was baking a birthday cake for the party.

translation.vi: Mình đang nướng một cái bánh sinh nhật cho bữa tiệc.

gloss.en: an event where people come together to have fun
food made with sugar and eggs, baked in an oven

grammar_notes: We use past continuous with 'when' to talk about an action that was happening at the same time as another action in the past.
interaction_prompts: What were you doing when someone surprised you?
